color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: One normalized event stream, plus the kernel's own events

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Which view?

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Status lines are written by code, not by a model
Raw logs are one click deep, behind a readable timeline
Lanes: Queued, Working, Waiting on you, Held, Verifying,
Integrating, Done. Done names the level and the cost
Explain, only when clicked, summarizes the last 50 events

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same events, drawn as a place. The toggle keeps chat, inbox and top bar
It never lies: no animation without an event. Calm office, calm build
CEO is the developer. Manager, Senior, Mid and Junior by clothes and props
A foreign sub-agent is a small helper at the parent's desk
Lab tech is the verifier. Guard is kernel policy
Same character for an agent's life. Hover shows model and connection
Desk color is the connection. No vendor logos

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Top bar on both: phase and wave, tasks done, spend per currency
Pause all checkpoints at the next boundary
Stop is a direct kernel path. The office keeps this ribbon too,
so nothing important exists only as an animation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Health, from events, with no model
No events for 5 minutes: possibly stuck. Nudge, interrupt, or open
Same tool or same failing command 3 times: looping
Rate limit: throttled, with the retry hint. Not a failure
Plan window closed: waiting for allowance, with the reset time
Moved up a level, or back to the author: escalated
Many workers: group cards by feature. Raw-by-default is a setting

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Anything that needs the developer enters one inbox

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owner first. The task author answers from the record when they can
Test disputes go to the author too. Most never reach the developer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
De-duplicate by criterion and scope. One item, many subscribers
Group by feature. A waiting worker takes another ready task if one exists

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: What kind of item?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Interrupt now. Banner, and a sound if enabled

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Batch. Deliver when 10 minutes close, or idle is threatened,
or a blocked task is on the critical path
Order: critical path, then how many tasks, then age
At most one batch alert per 10 minutes
Focus mode delivers only Interrupt now

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FYI digest. No alert
Away for an hour: unblocked work continues,
the batch waits, nothing is auto-answered

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Done means checked, not assumed
Decision: the answer validates
Secret: probe succeeds, or a format check plus first successful use
Tool: the re-probe succeeds
Account: a probe, or an attestation labeled not verified
Approval: approve or deny a risky action
Review: plan, design baseline, or I fixed it myself

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A secret is a name, a reason, the tasks, where to get it, a masked field
OS vault. SQLite stores a reference and the name
Injected as env into the verifier, tests and dev server that need it
The brief says the name is available, never the value
Redactor masks exact values and common encodings
A secret in a diff or a snapshot rejects the candidate
and raises Interrupt now. A secret pasted in chat is held,
offered to the vault, and deleted from history
A live-key prefix is refused in tests unless that task allows it
Known services get a harmless read. Unknown ones: format now,
verified on first success. Writing .env is off, and only if gitignored
A later rejection asks for an update

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A human step blocks only the tasks that need it
Playwright: version and a launch. Install in a visible terminal, after consent
Docker: docker info, then a link, then re-probe
A database: connection test. A cloud API: probe if a key or CLI exists,
otherwise a checklist and an attestation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CEO office: inbox. Open floor: attempts, in feature pods
Manager offices: the task list. Records room: graph and briefs
Meeting room: AskOwner, DisputeTest, planner questions
Test lab: verifier. Shipping dock: merge queue
Break room: rate limit, allowance, or a dependency, with the clock
Front desk: a human step. Vault: secrets, and only the guard enters
Server room: a local model, fans on while it generates

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Animation director between the stream and the characters
One queue each. Bursts collapse into one loop. A new state beats a walk
Over about two seconds behind: fade and reappear
Dwell about a second, so states do not flicker
Status icons update immediately

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
session.started: elevator to a free desk in the feature pod
Brief or contract read: records room and back
plan.updated: notebook and sticky notes
Read or search: scrolling text. Edit: typing a diff
Tests: a progress bar. Permission denied: the guard
AskOwner: meeting room. Answered from the record: a short meeting
Escalated: the manager carries paper to the CEO
Sub-agent: a helper. submit: carry a box to the lab
Pass: green lamp, then the dock, and a checkmark
Fail: red lamp, box back. Repeated fails: the manager's office
Level up: a Senior takes the desk. Rate limit: break room
Window closed: several in the break room, desks dim
Hold: watch the whiteboard update. User pause: pens down
Budget exhausted: evening light, folders, idle
Merged: the truck leaves. Looping or stuck: an amber question mark
Session ended: tidy and leave, or take the next desk

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Paper reaches the CEO only after owner checks and batching
Red is interrupt, yellow is blocking, white is FYI
The pile height is the inbox count. A batch is a stapled stack
Click the tray to open the inbox. Answering stamps the sheet
The manager walks it back. A secret or a tool is a parcel
at the front desk, not a decision sheet

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hover: name, level, model, task, time, tokens
Click: the same worker panel as the Board
Double-click zooms into the monitor. Esc zooms out
Right-click: pause, stop, message the manager, change level, fix it myself
Whiteboard: that feature's plan. Records: Architecture
Lab: verification. Dock: the merge queue. Tray and front desk: the inbox

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PixiJS. A Tiled map. Layered Aseprite sprites. A-star between rooms
One state machine per character, so it can be tested without drawing
Decided: cozy 16 px pixel art. Isometric later, as a skin
Commissioned or licensed art. No vendor logos
60 fps, under 5 percent CPU when idle, paused when hidden
About 30 characters animate. Beyond that, a hot-desk count
Reduced motion: stay seated, icons and labels only
Every state has text and an icon shape, not color alone
Tab cycles characters. A screen-reader list mirrors the room
Sound off by default

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Delivery stage

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Desks, rank, poses, the CEO tray, click-through panels
Exit: find the waiting task faster than on the Board

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Walking, meetings, lab, dock, break room
Exit: lag under 2 seconds with 10 workers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Avatar, character editor, layout editor, naming

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Day and night, an end-of-day recap, celebrations, optional sound

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Decided: name tags are the agent ID plus a short task title
Decided: the Office is the default build view. The Board is one click away
Reduced motion or memory pressure shows the Board instead
Cards separate thinking, waiting for a run slot, and running

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Instant task change: skip the walk, update the desk sign
Stream disconnect: freeze, show reconnecting, keep the last time
A tall inbox is a stack with a number. Helpers past three are a count
A small window zooms to the busiest pod, with a mini-map
In the background, rendering stops. On return, jump to current state

svg.text: Build cockpit and the office view of the same events
